notes.title: MEGABONK - OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
[h2]The Megabonk is here[/h2][p]it is time to bonk. [/p][p][/p][p]"megabonk is my favorite game, i think everybody should buy it right now" - Monke[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45369804/805e6dad9a1bf5b8fbd28db3be744aed519d9ccd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hope you guys like it! notes.title: Megabonk News
notes.content: [h2]YO[/h2][p]This is a lil update on the progress on Megabonk since the demo launched. I'm hoping to release the full game soon, in about a month or something (early September), but I'll post an exact date soon. [/p][p]Anyway here's what I've been cooking for the full release:[/p][p][/p][h3]Characters \[20 / 20][/h3][p]I've finished 20 characters so far, all with unique weapons and passive, and I might create some more before launch if I have time. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45369804/185c235a0c2b34f810558cdc8df79025f7736dfc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Weapons \[28 / 30][/h3][p]28 weapons are done so far, and I'm planning do to at least 30. Hopefully a bit more than that before launch.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45369804/686cfb982101ef6cc3dc9804938ce8c12bed593f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Items \[65 / 100][/h3][p]There's 65 items currently, so ill have to cook up a few more there. If you have any suggestions, i'm very open to hear them![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45369804/bb8e64d2874b4af914af170934acdbb89b9e473a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]New Maps[/h3][p]I'm working on new maps as well, but it takes a lot of time to make all the enemies for every map. I'm planning to launch with two maps and then hopefully add more. Each map also has 3 stages.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45369804/cb6c89e39fe50abd7d9d589f5dd55ad1b47f1f77.png"][/img][/p][h3]Hoverboard[/h3][p]yeah we got a fucking hoverboard now (it's sick)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45369804/13206305b8a6d1a3963a80f10f5b71b3a28fe359.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Other[/h3][list][*][p]5+ unlockable skins for every character[/p][/*][*][p]Full Controller support and no more shitty controller bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Sliding mechanic[/p][/*][*][p]More music[/p][/*][*][p]More stages[/p][/*][*][p]Final Boss Fight :o[/p][/*][*][p]Map Challenges[/p][/*][*][p]New Tomes[/p][/*][*][p]Localization to 18 different languages[/p][/*][*][p]And much more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]After Launch[/h3][p]I'm gonna keep adding a lot more content after launch. I've got a lot maps, items, weapons, characters, challenges and achievements lined up, so that will all be coming out with regular updates after launch![/p][p][/p][h3]Wishlist[/h3][p]Guys we're at 65k wishlists!!! smash wishlist and maybe we can get to 100k!!! [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks guy :)[/p][p]cya soon ✌️[/p]
